en: Storage abstractions: Datalake, Data lakehouse, Data platform, Cloud data warehouse.
Storage systems: HDFS, RDBMS, Object storage, Cache/memory-based storage, Streaming storage.
Storage "raw ingredients": HSS, SSD, RAM, Networking, Serialization, Compression, CPU.
Serialization is about converting data from one form to another.

Object storage manages its data as objects. An object is a discrete unit of data that is stored with its own unique identifier. Objects may have a data component that holds the actual content of the object. This can be any type of data. Objects have thier own unique identifiers. Metadata provides additional information about the object.
In data lake you're just storing a bunch of different data types together.
Combining the notion of a data warehouse and data lake is a data lake house.
data management: use data catalogues, data versioning.
